note: Invented people only. Seeds are fixed so the pictures can be made again exactly.

sequences.name: Celery Man
sequences.prompt: Celery Man: a slim, clean-shaven man around forty with short dark-brown hair and a confident, slightly smug face, wearing an oversized shiny silver-grey sharkskin suit with a 1980s cut: wide padded shoulders, the jacket worn open, baggy pleated trousers. Under it a plain white dress shirt with a thin, loosened dark-grey tie, a black belt with a silver buckle, and black dress shoes. Dance: cheesy, self-satisfied showman moves to the beat: he pops one hip out, bounces on his knees, pumps both fists up and down by his shoulders and shimmies his shoulders, grinning smugly the whole time

sequences.name: Oyster
sequences.prompt: Oyster: a slim, clean-shaven man around forty with short dark-brown hair, wearing a snug red knit skull cap whose top is dark navy blue with a red flame pattern, an open red zip-up track jacket with white stripes down the sleeves over a plain black T-shirt, a black studded choker necklace, black trousers and black shoes. Dance: goofy bent-forward bouncing and head-banging, then popping back up straight

sequences.name: Tayne
sequences.prompt: Tayne: a slim, clean-shaven man around forty with short dark-brown hair, wearing a black hat with a low flat-topped crown and a wide, stiff, flat brim sitting clearly on top of his head, black wrap-around sunglasses, a thin gold chain necklace, a loud long-sleeved silk shirt with a baroque scroll print in orange-gold and black, tucked into shiny black leather trousers, and black leather boots. Dance: a wide-legged squat groove with both arms flexed up beside the head, then a confident strut on the spot and a little kick

sequences.name: Tayne (beach costume)
sequences.prompt: Tayne in his silly beach costume: the same slim, clean-shaven man around forty, now wearing a bright lime-green sling-style one-piece comedy swimsuit with two wide straps over the shoulders, and two big puffy yellow inflatable swim rings stacked around his waist and hips, the top one with a rubber-duck head: the two thick tubes completely hide the bottom of the swimsuit and everything from the belly button down to the upper thighs, together with the same black flat-brimmed hat sitting on top of his head, the same black wrap-around sunglasses, the thin gold chain and the black leather boots. A goofy, non-sexual beach gag costume. Dance: a wide-legged groove with both arms flexed up beside the head, then a confident strut on the spot
